author: The Current
description:
Anna Graves explains why she put "Burn On," written at age 16, on her new album
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Anna Graves' new album, "America’s Greatest Burnout," — her debut on Rounder Records — includes a song called "Burn On," which Graves had written at age 16. Remarkably, "Burn On" contained a message from 16-year-old Anna to her adult self. "I thought, 'I have lost my wonder,'" Graves says. "It takes discipline to have wonder."

Hear more of what Graves has to say about that discipline in the video above from her recent interview with The Current's Zach McCormick.
